summary: This plugin adds a Chat/Work session-mode toggle in DeepSeek Harness and keeps non-project chat sessions grouped under a dedicated Chat workspace in the sidebar for easier switching between chat and project work.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is best classified as a navigation/interaction enhancement for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: it adds a Chat/Work session-mode toggle and a managed Chat workspace surfaced in the sidebar so users can separate non-project chat from project work sessions. Evidence shows it does not add new model behavior or external integrations; its primary action is organizing session presentation and navigation by registering modes, deriving mode from workspace membership, and applying local workspace/preset housekeeping in the harness profile.
